description: Nothing out of the ordinary. The valley goes about its business.
Overnight rain has cut the hillsides back. Ore sits proud of the rock today.
Warm ground has brought the herbs on early. They will not last the week.
The stands have thrown up new shoots overnight. Cut them while they are tender.
A rare day when everything is worth picking. Take what the valley offers.
Something came down over the pass in the night. The rock glitters where you break it.
A hard wind stripped the canopy overnight. Leaf mould lies thick around every herb patch.
